prompts.battle: Reference image is decoded Elder Scrolls Arena HOUND original identity and animation, not to be copied pixel-for-pixel. Powerful long-bodied hell hound with heavily muscled tall shoulder and deep chest, low narrow waist and strong hocks, pointed low small ears, long narrow muzzle, tapering swept-down tail. Almost-black coal/blue-black fur, visible charcoal cool gray modeling and edge highlights so playable against dark stone; little glowing deep red eyes; muted orange mouth interior glimpsed. Four canine legs total. No horns, collar, armor, wings, skeletal parts, additional heads, platform, scenery, floor shadow, labels. Painterly figurative dark-fantasy game sprite, lit from upper-left with deliberately readable matte shapes, NOT vector, pixel art or blurred photograph. Frames all isolated on actual transparent alpha with large gutters and full silhouettes. One transparent landscape combat atlas exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, equal grid, sixteen separately articulated full-body sprites, true LATERAL profile facing LEFT in every living pose (enemy on right fighting hero on left). Reference HOUND3 for long flank; living body approx. same height in all rows, no drifting. Each drawing max 70% cell width and 68% height, strong blank margins. Row 1 four subtle standing/breathing frames with paws firmly planted. Row 2 four attack frames: lower head bend legs anticipation; reach forward; jaws snap/lunge left with rear feet braced; withdraw to standing. No projectile. Row 3 four hurt frames: standing; head recoils up/back, recoil on shoulders; rebound with elbows bent; standing. Row 4 four defeat frames: forelegs buckle; torso falls on its side; collapsed silhouette dissolves in tiny localized warm copper cinders (original animation); distinctly inert low ash-and-ember silhouette. Four columns in each row. No extra images.
